newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia INA says Oct oil output 20 pct above plan.
newsitem.headline: Croatia INA says Oct oil output 20 pct above plan.

text.p: Croatia's state-owned oil firm INA Industrija Nafte said on Monday its October output, totalling 106,537 tonnes of crude and 35,430 tonnes of condensate, overshot plans by some 20 percent.
Oil and derivatives output reached 1.93 million tonnes in the first 10 months this year, or 2.3 percent more than planned, INA said in its weekly company newspaper.
Almost 900,000 tonnes of the crude in the Jan-Oct peropd came from Croatian oilfields while 173,000 tonnes were imported from Angola and 9,700 from Egypt.
INA produced some 150 million cubic metres of natural gas in October and imported 77 million from Russia.
Its total natural gas output in the first 10 months was around 2.2 billion cubic metres.
